List rule runs, newest first; runs are kept 30 days

## Usage

```text
chainmail rule runs [<id|name>] [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail rule runs
chainmail rule runs receipts --outcome failed
```

## Flags

```text
      --account string   only runs on this account
      --before-id int    only runs older than this ID, from next_before_id
      --limit int32      rows per page, 1 to 500 (default 50)
      --outcome string   only runs that ended this way: ok, capped, failed, cache_not_ready or interrupted
      --trigger string   only runs started this way: new, schedule or manual
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
